claim: Factory-level fix-hunk detection on the 161 recall-study advisories. The combined number is NOT held out: CodeQL results are untuned stock queries, pattern results are exposed (developed on these advisories).

codeql_lane.query_selection: suite queries whose external/cwe tags share a class family with the advisory; other queries cannot produce a class-matching hit
create_argv: [--build-mode=none for java and csharp; autobuild for go]
codeql_lane.source_scope: whole repository at the parent of the first fix commit (source_revision); detections are primary result locations
codeql_lane.environment: Measurement host with an outbound proxy. Python, JavaScript and Ruby extraction does not fetch dependencies; Go autobuild and Java/C# build-mode none may have. Production workers run with network none.

registrations.codeql_sample_scope: 15 per ecosystem drawn from rounds 7-8; 52 of the 161 were in that sample
registrations.codeql_extension: Not pre-registered: the 36 remaining PyPI, npm and RubyGems advisories of the 161 were added afterwards. Go, Maven and crates.io advisories outside the sample were never run.

detection_rule.hunk: old-side lines of `git diff -U5 <parent> <fix>` hunks in changed in-language files outside test paths, per (parent, path)
detection_rule.class_match: rule CWE family equals an advisory CWE family (CWE-297 and CWE-295 are one family)

exposure.codeql: Untuned stock queries. The decision to add a Ruby worker was informed by part of these results.
exposure.pattern: Exposed: the Java trust-all and Ruby TLS shapes were developed on a set containing all 161 advisories; a fresh trust check (registration 1a7688a8...) moved 2/79 to 10/79.

rejected_levers.codeql_threat_model_all: 25 paired advisories, 0 differences from the default threat model

php_library_input_rule.fresh_precision: 0 supported, 19 false positive, 1 unclear of 20 (consensus of two reviewers)

rejected_levers.parameter_source_rules_go_ruby_java: development +12/224 for ~900 findings on ~1,100 files; not shipped
